audit_metadata.auditor_role: Data Governance Officer & Independent Validation Lead
audit_metadata.purpose: Authoritative evidence inventory of independent external atypical speech resources
audit_metadata.verification_standard: Official first-party institutional portals and published peer-reviewed citations

UA-Speech.dataset_name: UA-Speech (Dysarthric Speech Database for Universal Access Research)
UA-Speech.custodian_department: Statistical Speech Technology Group, Department of ECE
UA-Speech.primary_citation: Kim, H., Hasegawa-Johnson, M., Perlman, A., Gunderson, J., Huang, T. S., Watkin, K., & Frame, S. (2008). Dysarthric speech database for universal access research. Interspeech 2008, 1741-1744.
UA-Speech.eligibility_criteria: Researchers at government and academic research laboratories only. Commercial use strictly prohibited.
request_requirements: Institution Name (must be school or government research lab)
Cloud Storage Account (Google Drive, iCloud, or OneDrive) for delivery
UA-Speech.redistribution_terms: Recipients must ensure the data is protected against theft and must NOT redistribute it. Full license in LICENSE.txt upon delivery.

cohort_composition.speech_task: Isolated words (digits, radio alphabet, computer commands, phonetically rich vocabulary)

UA-Speech.emergency_labels_finding: Source-verified: UASpeech contains exclusively lexical word prompts; zero emergency-intent or distress annotations exist.
UA-Speech.independence_vs_torgo: 100% geographically and institutionally independent. Illinois vs Toronto cohorts.

Speech_Accessibility_Project.custodian_institution: Beckman Institute for Advanced Science and Technology, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
Speech_Accessibility_Project.primary_citation: Speech Accessibility Project Consortium. (2023). The Speech Accessibility Project: Advancing Automatic Speech Recognition for Individuals with Non-Standard Speech. Beckman Institute for Advanced Science and Technology, UIUC.
Speech_Accessibility_Project.eligibility_criteria: Accredited academic, government, or industry accessibility researchers with countersigned institutional DUA.
request_requirements: One-page research proposal detailing project scope, methodology, and security controls
Signature from Institutional Authorized Official with legal binding authority
Review by UIUC Office of Technology Management (~3 weeks)
Speech_Accessibility_Project.redistribution_terms: Redistribution and patient re-identification strictly prohibited. Maximum 3-year agreement term.
Speech_Accessibility_Project.commercial_terms: Non-commercial exploratory accessibility research under standard DUA.

cohort_composition.speech_task: Sentence reading, conversational prompts, voice assistant commands

Speech_Accessibility_Project.emergency_labels_finding: Source-verified: SAP collects conversational and assistive prompts; zero emergency-intent or distress labels exist.
Speech_Accessibility_Project.independence_vs_torgo: 100% geographically and clinically independent of TORGO.

Nemours.dataset_name: The Nemours Database of Dysarthric Speech
Nemours.custodian_institution: Nemours Children's Health & University of Delaware
Nemours.custodian_department: Pediatric Speech Research Laboratory, Wilmington, DE
Nemours.access_channel: Inquiries to Nemours Pediatric Speech Research Laboratory
Nemours.primary_citation: Bunnell, H. T., Yarrington, D., Polikoff, J., et al. (1996). The Nemours Database of Dysarthric Speech. In Proceedings of the International Conference on Spoken Language Processing (ICSLP), 1996.
Nemours.eligibility_criteria: Academic speech researchers upon formal bilateral agreement.
Nemours.historical_distribution: Physical CD-ROM distribution (circa 1996). No modern public self-service download.

cohort_composition.etiology: Cerebral Palsy, Stroke, Closed Head Trauma
cohort_composition.speech_task: 74 short syntactically controlled sentences per speaker

Nemours.emergency_labels_finding: Source-verified: Syntactically controlled sentences only; zero emergency content.

PC-GITA.custodian_department: GITA Research Group, Faculty of Medicine
PC-GITA.access_channel: Direct formal inquiry to lead researchers via GITA
PC-GITA.primary_citation: Orozco-Arroyave, J. R., et al. (2014). Apkinson: A mobile application for Parkinson's disease assessment. IEEE Healthcare Technology Letters.
PC-GITA.eligibility_criteria: Medical and clinical ML researchers with institutional ethics approval.

cohort_composition.speech_task: Diadochokinetic tasks, vowels, phonetically balanced words and read text

PC-GITA.emergency_labels_finding: Clinical diagnostic speech battery; zero emergency intent labels.

Project_Euphonia.access_channel: UNAVAILABLE (Google directs external researchers to Speech Accessibility Project)
Project_Euphonia.primary_citation: MacDonald, K., et al. (2021). Project Euphonia: Personalised Speech Recognition for Non-Standard Speech. Google Research.

cohort_composition.total_speakers: >1,000 individuals with diverse neurological speech impairments

Project_Euphonia.emergency_labels_finding: Asset is entirely inaccessible to external investigators.
Project_Euphonia.independence_vs_torgo: Independent, but legally and technically unavailable.

TORGO.custodian_department: Department of Computer Science & Speech-Language Pathology
TORGO.primary_citation: Rudzicz, F., McNamara, D. S., & Brown, M. (2012). The TORGO database of acoustic and articulatory speech from speakers with dysarthria. Language Resources and Evaluation, 46(4), 523-541.
TORGO.repository_status: Present in repository: 6,067 prompt utterances across 15 speakers (4,852 train / 1,215 test)
TORGO.independence_vs_torgo: 0% INDEPENDENT. Fully contaminated by prior training, hyperparameter tuning, and diagnostic auditing across Phases 1 through 8.2.
TORGO.suitability_verdict: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Strictly barred from serving as confirmatory validation evidence.
